design: Continual / few-shot / meta-learning loop that re-learns as regimes shift, in three instantiations: (i) the frozen 819 rule (sign of 30d return, equal weight, H=1; `trader/config.py:96-104`) with its lookback re-selected walk-forward from {7,14,30,60,90} by trailing net@21 Sharpe (yearly / monthly / 2y window / hysteresis), or Hedge over the five lookback books; (ii) a rolling cross-sectional ridge on the memo's market-residual, vol-standardised target whose estimation window is chosen by an Inoue–Jin–Rossi quadratic-loss rule or Bayesian changepoint resets, fed unchanged to a Gârleanu–Pedersen controller; (iii) an X-Trend-style few-shot learner (CPD-segmented regime context set, cross-attention, positions out) or MAML over regimes. The proposal's own thesis: the learned object is a time path θ_t whose only content beyond a static estimator is Var(IC_t)·φ (time-variation and persistence of the local IC); the selector's profit decomposes as Σπ_k μ_k (≤0 on 2024–26 for every measured arm) + Σ Cov(1{k chosen}, R_k) − c·switch turnover; fast adaptation is "below the detection floor" because per-date IC SD ≈ 1/√N_eff ≈ 0.35 gives w* ≈ 540 d for IC 0.03; a CPU-only kill experiment (selector arms A/B1–B4/C/D/N on the PIT 273-asset panel + per-year cross-sectional IC vs 200 circular-shift placebos + monthly-IC autocorrelation τ) decides it. Self-assessed odds of the goalposts 1–2%.
lens: AMPLIFIER-NOT-SOURCE — assume the loop only amplifies the information in its training targets; ask what information the learned object carries that a direct estimator lacks; redo the arithmetic; check gross/net, IS/OOS, years, in every literature number; default refuted=true if uncertain.
strongest_objection: The best case for the design is that it is the only "regime" proposal so far that converts regime talk into two measurable scalars at near-zero cost — σ_date (hence N_eff, the memo's one unmeasured term) and the monthly-IC persistence τ — and that its central detection-floor number is likely WRONG in the direction that helps it: σ_date = 1/√N_eff ≈ 0.35 imports the memo's breadth guess for 64 raw-return assets (`lore/fable_direction_memo_2026-09-03.md:162-167`, "to be measured"), whereas the per-date Spearman IC on a market-residual, vol-standardised target over the 239–267 assets live in 2024–25 (`runs/819_single_asset/POWERED_RESULT.md` coverage table) has an exchangeable-null SD of 1/√(N−1) ≈ 0.06–0.07, rising toward 1/√N_eff,residual only to the extent the trend signal loads on residual sector factors. Re-doing w* = (2σ/IC)² at IC 0.03: σ=0.065 → 19 days; σ=0.15 → 100 days; σ=0.35 → 544 days. So a 3–6-month rolling estimator may well be above the detection floor, and then a persistently time-varying IC_t could be tracked. Answer under the lens: granted, and it changes nothing about the source of information. A rolling ridge with a 4-month window IS a direct estimator; the window length is a hyperparameter, and the quantity it depends on — IC autocorrelation φ_h — is ALREADY a planned output of the memo's §4 instrument ("signal decay φ_h estimated from the IC autocorrelation", memo:277-279) because Gârleanu–Pedersen needs it. The loop therefore carries exactly the information the memo's direct instrument produces as a by-product, plus estimation variance. For instantiation (i), the objection does not even apply: arm-level Sharpe SE ≈ 1.0/yr is a MEASURED CI width (2024 net@8 CI[−1.99,+2.10], `experiments/LEDGER.md:103`), independent of N_eff, so selecting among five lookbacks by trailing-1y Sharpe is selecting among draws whose noise (SE 1.0) exceeds any plausible true spread; that half of the design is dead on the record's own numbers.
amplifier_check: VERDICT: amplifier only; the loop creates no information, and the proposal itself concedes this in every field. Instantiation by instantiation. (i) Lookback/tactic selector: its targets are trailing realised arm P&Ls; θ_t is a deterministic function of them; the only exploitable content is the lag-autocorrelation of the arm-return DIFFERENTIALS — a one-line direct estimator (regress next-period arm spread on trailing spread) reads it with less variance than argmax-over-arms does (forecast-combination puzzle: Smith–Wallis 2009 / Claeskens et al. 2016, search-snippet depth; the repo's own number is the equal-weight lookback ensemble at −0.16 net@8, `runs/819_single_asset/PORTFOLIO_RESULT.md` lever table, turnover 0.162→0.177). Hedge over arms adds a learning rate, not information; Hedge with a flat arm is the 887 fixed point (`LEDGER.md:97`: A −2.855% / E −9.106% / D −13.844%, monotone in activity, fee 0). (ii) Rolling ridge with a learned window: a direct estimator plus one hyperparameter whose optimal value is set by IC autocorrelation φ_h, which the memo's instrument already estimates (memo:277-279); Pesaran–Timmermann 2007 (snippet) prices the hyperparameter — post-break-only windows lose to windows that include pre-break data because variance dominates bias. (iii) X-Trend / MAML over regimes: a kernel forecaster whose targets are returns under a Sharpe loss; it amplifies the conditional mean in those targets; its published increment is +18.9% over a DMN that already sits at 2.27 Sharpe, at C(i)=0 ("For this paper we set C(i)=0 rather than assuming a cost for each asset" — verified in the arXiv 2310.10500 full text via pdftotext; Table 1 2018–23: Long 0.48, TSMOM 0.23, MACD 0.27, baseline 2.27, X-Trend-Q 2.70; Table 2 zero-shot: TSMOM −0.26, X-Trend J-Gauss 0.47; 50 Pinnacle futures, 10 seeds; 87.4% deterioration sentence verified). The repo has already measured the nonlinear ceiling ≤ linear on this surface (`runs/819_single_asset/CAPACITY_RESULT.md`: MLP train IC +0.1882 vs OOS +0.0358; verdict SIGNAL-LIMITED) and the tactics panel prices the DMN family's break-even at 2–3 bp/side vs 21 bp (`lore/fable_tactics_panel_2026-09-04.md:55-59`). Arithmetic re-done and confirmed where it does not depend on N_eff: annual Sharpe SE ≈ 1/√T_yr → 1.04 (2024 CI width 4.09), 0.91 (2025), 1.6 for 2026H1 (half year, expected 1.41); cost drag 0.152/day × 365 × 21 bp = 11.65%/yr, /0.18 Sharpe → σ_book ≈ 65%; L=7 turnover 0.362 vs 0.154 (`RESULT.md` 1d table, single-asset BTC — the portfolio's 0.152–0.155 matches the single-asset L=30 figure, so the extrapolation is fair) → +15.9%/yr fees ≈ −0.25 Sharpe. Arithmetic NOT confirmed: σ_date = 0.35 (see objection) — it is a conjecture the kill experiment measures, not a fact the design rests on; the proposal's phrase "that is the design's whole content" therefore describes a design with no established content. Under the memo's load-bearing doubt (IC_t ≈ 0 everywhere) the proposal's own valuation — negative, −0.15 to −0.3 vs the frozen rule — is the right sign: every refit is a re-trim, and 892 measured maintenance re-trims as the OOS anti-edge locus (`LEDGER.md:102`, Δ −0.050/−0.056/−0.043 vs matched null, every CI < 0). Note finally that this is not the operator's question: nothing here learns a pattern that SERVES Monte Carlo evaluation; the only MC connection is "MuZero as the K-arm selector", which the tactics panel already prices at 3–5% and the memo reduces to a controller that Gârleanu–Pedersen does in closed form (memo:211-216). The operator's actual idea — a learned world-model/leaf inside search — is the record's deepest negative (`LEDGER.md:74` 849/leaf v̂ corr +0.03; E5-inversion3 +8.02 is a true-env lookahead) and the one untested ansatz, Bella-as-rollouts (`docs/findings/encoder_bella_class_closed.md:29`), is priced by memo §5: a generator calibrated to history carries no drift information beyond a forecaster.

surviving_claim: Nothing in the design is a source of edge, a reason for GPU, or a re-entry for a learned loop; the operator's half-expectation is correct and the proposal says so itself. What survives is two cheap by-products that belong to existing rows, not to a new lane: (1) fold the per-year cross-sectional IC read WITH a 200-shift circular placebo AND the monthly-IC autocorrelation (with its own placebo band) into the memo's §4 G-A instrument — the memo already demands IC > 0 in 2024, 2025, 2026H1 separately (memo:305-306) and already plans φ_h from IC autocorrelation (memo:277-279); the σ_date by-product measures N_eff (memo:145, TASK_825 PARKED) and decides every future 'regime' proposal's detection window at once; (2) add the five lookback books, the yearly/monthly walk-forward selector, the ex-post oracle and the equal-weight ensemble as one more K-arm instance of the tactics panel's row 1 (`lore/fable_tactics_panel_2026-09-04.md:103-110`), scored against the 200-seed random-selector null AND an oracle null. If G-A passes and the measured φ_h is large, the ridge's refit window becomes a pre-registered Inoue–Jin–Rossi choice inside the GP book — a hyperparameter of a direct estimator, which is the only legitimate form 'continual learning' takes here. CPU minutes to hours, zero GPU, ~100 lines of wrapper over `trader.strategy.positions_from_config` and `experiments/898_trend_decay/decay_harness.py:262 score_window`.
kill_experiment_critique: The experiment is well-instrumented (unmodified `trader.backtest` scorer via `decay_harness.py:262`, hash-gated pre-registration `:308-346`, PIT builder `trader/data.py:426`) and cheap, but five defects would let a null world escape or a spurious SURVIVE fire. (1) τ has no null. At h=7 and h=21 the forward-return targets of adjacent days overlap, so the MONTHLY mean-IC series has mechanical positive lag-1 autocorrelation under the null (month m's last ~21 daily ICs share target windows with month m+1's first ~21); the SURVIVE clause 'lag-1..3 autocorrelation > 0 at t ≥ 2' will trip on overlap alone at h=21. Fix: compute the autocorrelation on each of the 200 circular-shift placebos and require the observed value above the placebo 95th percentile; or use non-overlapping h-day blocks. (2) τ is under-powered anyway: n = 30 months (2024-01→2026-06) or 54 (from 2022); t ≥ 2 needs ρ ≥ 0.27–0.37, so a true φ of 0.2 — enough to matter for a rolling window — is undetectable, and 'τ > w*' will almost surely read inconclusive rather than kill or survive. State that in the SPEC so the planner does not read 'no significant autocorrelation' as 'no persistence'. (3) KILL-3 has no oracle null. Under IC = 0 with five books of inter-book correlation ρ ≈ 0.6–0.8 and per-year SE ≈ 1.0, the ex-post per-year best reads ≈ A + √(1−ρ)·1.163 ≈ A + 0.5–0.75 by selection alone, so 'oracle ≥ +0.97' fires by chance perhaps 30–45% of the time when A ≈ 0 and means nothing; report the oracle against the oracle-of-placebo distribution, not against +0.97 alone (the +0.97 comparison remains valid as a necessary-condition kill). (4) KILL-1 is weak as a kill: 2 estimators × 3 horizons × 3 years = 18 two-sided 95% cells → P(all inside | null) ≈ 0.95^18 ≈ 0.40 if independent, perhaps 0.5–0.6 with correlation, so roughly half of null worlds end with neither KILL-1 nor SURVIVE and the question '875's gap = regime shift or no signal' stays open. Redefine KILL-1 as the complement of the SURVIVE IC clause (no estimator × horizon has ≥ 2 of 3 years outside the band), which fires ≈ 96% under the null. (5) Multiplicity over B1–B4 is uncorrected: B* is the best of four correlated selector variants but the N arm is a random-L null, not a best-of-four-rule-based null; either Bonferroni the four or draw the null as best-of-four random selectors. Two smaller points: the '>50% flat = FAIL' clause is vacuous for sign books (see record_conflicts) — add a flat arm if the 887 attractor is meant to be tested, otherwise drop the clause; and the ridge in the ceiling read is expanding-window, so instantiation (ii)'s rolling-window claim is never directly tested — acceptable only because (ii) is conditional on G-A, which should be said. Compute stays ≤ 0.5 CPU-day with all fixes; the placebo autocorrelation adds ~200 cheap series. With the fixes the experiment is a legitimate one-line extension of G-A plus a row-1 K-arm instance; without them its most likely outcome (selector arms A − 0.1..−0.3, oracle +0.5..+1.2, IC inside the band) would be read as 'inconclusive on persistence' rather than the clean kill the proposal expects.
